Maya (partnerships): quick heads-up — StackSmith (partner) asked for a one-click terraform quickstart that provisions a minimal Redwood inference stack on AWS + GCP. Need a short pairing sync to scope modules, marketplace packaging, and a lightweight smoke test. @Naveen @Jules? :wave:

Naveen (cloud-eng): I can pair on the TF modules. Quick question: do we need cross-account IAM patterns baked in (assume role / service account) or keep it simple for the marketplace listing? Also, will partners want an opinionated VPC + subnets by default?

Jules (solutions): I'd recommend two modules: `redwood_stacksmith_core` (model-serving infra, autoscaling hooks, KV/cache options) and `marketplace_wrapper` (packaging + listing metadata + license hooks). Keep core param-driven so Dedicated vs Hosted options are toggles. :+1:

Samira (docs): I’ll own the quickstart README and examples. Can one of you paste a minimal usage snippet (vars with defaults) and a suggested smoke test command I can copy into docs?

Naveen (cloud-eng): minimal usage snippet below. We'll keep defaults non-prod and clearly label required partner steps.

```hcl
module "redwood_stacksmith_core" {
  source = "github.com/redwood-inference/terraform-modules//redwood_stacksmith_core"
  region = var.region
  instance_type = "g4dn.xlarge"
  enable_kv_cache = true
  public_subnets = var.public_subnets
  deployment_mode = "marketplace" # options: hosted, dedicated, private
}
```

Suggested smoke test: `curl -sS https://{lb_dns}/healthz | grep -q \"ok\"` and `terraform apply -auto-approve` followed by a quick inference request using our sample curl POST.

ci-bot: CI: opened PR #412 in `partners/stacksmith-quickstarts` with initial module skeleton. Tests: lint ✅, fmt ✅, terraform-docs pending. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/partners/pull/412 :robot_face:

Maya (partnerships): awesome. Action items: Naveen — finish skeleton & add variable docs by EOW; Jules — smoke harness + matrix (aws/gcp) for 2 cloud types; Samira — draft README + quick runbook. I’ll sync with StackSmith PM on marketplace listing windows and any legal metadata. Please drop progress in this thread when PR/README ready. Thanks all! :tada:
